notes: No source found that compares ultimate-parent refusal rates by LEI issuer, or that names Bloomberg as the registrar where most US refusals sit. GLEIF publishes per-LOU data quality reports, including Bloomberg's (e.g. 2022-07-07 and April 2018 PDFs surfaced in search), but the 2022 PDF returned 404 and those reports score field-level data quality checks, not refusal shares; not recorded. No news or trade-press coverage of the pattern surfaced. One logged query (the OFR one) was expanded by the search tool into several internal searches, so searching stopped at 6 logged queries to stay inside the per-story cap. No recent (Jul-Sep 2026) coverage query was run separately; none of the results were dated in that window.
